heading: The Engine
sub: A complete algorithmic trading pipeline, engineered to be fast and resource-efficient.
benchmark_note: 50 symbols · 3 years · 1-minute OHLCV · multiple strategies · multiple exits · full engine in under 3 minutes.
architecture_blurb: Performance comes from architecture, not from throwing CPU at the problem.
pipeline_note: The same logic runs against historical data for backtesting and against real-time data.
